theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_fcp_immersion_image_open_in_subspace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H = m → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → (∀ v ∈ B, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ v)) → ψ '' B ⊆ (H : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ O ∩ (H : Set (Euclid P)) = ψ '' B
